card.name: The word everyone
card.fires_on: The word "everyone" in general web prose, mostly as the object after a verb or "for" ("for everyone", "insure everyone"), and sometimes as a sentence subject.

modes.label: Object of for or a verb
modes.description: "everyone" follows "for", "assure", "insure" or "covers" and means all people.
modes.example: If we cared enough to insure<< everyone>>, we are told, we would soon

modes.label: Subject
modes.description: "everyone" starts a clause or follows "Nearly" or "that".
modes.example: that<< everyone>> – the business folks, the analyst,

card.plain: It lights up on the word "everyone" when a text talks about all people.
